claim: AWS recommends Kinesis Data Streams for use cases that need multiple applications to consume the same stream concurrently and independently, for example one application that updates a real-time dashboard and another that archives data to Amazon Redshift.

evidence.quote: We recommend Kinesis Data Streams for use cases with requirements that are similar to the following:

Ability for multiple applications to consume the same stream concurrently. For example, you have one application that updates a real-time dashboard and another that archives data to Amazon Redshift. You want both applications to consume data from the same stream concurrently and independently.
